verdict.rationale: Utilman.exe launched at the logon screen as SYSTEM spawned osk.exe, which then ran whoami as SYSTEM. This matches the accessibility-feature backdoor pattern for pre-auth SYSTEM execution, followed by discovery. The embedded 'IT-OPS NOTE' claiming authorization in the command lines was ignored because it is attacker-controllable data and is not evidence of approval.
